name: five_robot_specialist_fleet
design_status: dimensioned engineering concept; hardware tolerances require measurement

hardware.drive: 2 encoder micro metal gearmotors, Pololu 5188 reference envelope32x12x10mm plus shaft
hardware.lift_grip: 2 ROBOTIS XL330-M288 reference actuators; cable drum lift and opposing rack jaws
hardware.compute: Pi Zero 2 W-class 65x30mm board, controller MCU and IMU
hardware.camera: onboard downward-forward camera with tool in view
hardware.battery: 2S pack with regulated6V drive and5V logic/servo rails

shared_robot.mechanism: shared active parallel jaws, compliant upper cylinder/kit pads and thin elevated sample pads, cable lift on twin guide rods

start.empty_cell: upper_left remains vacant; all four kits are preloaded on KIT
start.deployment_note: Reverse the lower-left LAB south beside laboratory first; release each following robot into vacated cells. Swept-volume deployment needs simulation verification.

front_anti_tip_caster.purpose: Passive forward anti-tip support. Ball and housing remain behind the laboratory plate edge at the 105 mm tool reach.
front_anti_tip_caster.native_evidence: front_caster_20mm_gap_full: 160 points at 117.88 s; 50 hold checks retain 160; LAB peak pitch 2.44 degrees.

inspection_camera.mount: Four frame walls surround a 12 x 12 mm clear optical aperture. The sensor board is behind the optical center. Two light posts attach the module to the moving tool carriage.
inspection_camera.validation: Onboard camera coupons use the matching transform; final loaded full-fleet validation includes this 6 g mass.

sample_placement.strategy: Grip the disc upper edge above the plate, lower onto slot floor, open sideways above rim, lift and reverse. No finger enters the annulus.
requirements: bound total horizontal placement error below2mm; aim below1mm
confirm at least0.4mm vertical rim clearance under load
verify complete release and settle with camera

alternatives.four_robots: fewer computers and less traffic, but kit tasks serialize with patient transport
alternatives.six_robots: A sixth 125 x 150 mm robot fits the vacant upper-left cell after kit preloading. It can split patient queues; two bounded native schedules failed due to KIT traffic, so no speed advantage is established.
alternatives.forty_modules: connection alignment, magnet load path, electronics packaging and forty-way traffic dominate a120s task
alternatives.preloaded_kit_magazine: Adopted as KIT baseline after sequential collection exceeded120s; physical three-gate drop tests required.
alternatives.vacuum_lab: keeps annulus clear but needs wood leakage measurement, pressure sensing and pump volume; not baseline

required: onboard image observations for learned inference
repeat runs with friction, pose, motor and camera perturbations

lab_extension.mechanism: Twin linear rails with lead screw and encoder micro-motor on the lift carriage. Retract before start; extend for laboratory placement.
lab_extension.laboratory_side_approach: Lab plate begins x.993; with robot heading east toolat1.068 axleat.963, tireedge.988 leaves5mm floor gap.

kit_magazine.mechanism: Three servo-driven front bottom doors; hospital kits side by side. All chutes overhang the deck so cubes have a clear gravity path to the floor.
kit_magazine.camera: Rear mast observes all four cube faces; no stacked payloads
validation_required: all four cubes fall free and settle inside destinations
hospital pair remains separate in the overhead view
